book.name: 1 KORIN
book.title: KORIN KHRISAWBU KHATEI PAUL CAKUA UIKHEHNAH

content: Meh ziachaw ly uny cawh papia thlang o
Naa hrong letah hmingchahly a cangpaw canu capaw suanah, lawki cawngsaw sahlo tahmai tah aa tua bang lypaw phing a ung tah aa reipaw ka thui. Pakhehpaw tah a paw a nupuino a suakhui aa tah.
Ma hming cawh na palaikhui thlang he ceh! Lung reithui tah chi tah, ma hming a tuapaw cawngsaw khah naa hrong taitah papia ly tamaw naa ung thlang?

Ka pung tah naaning kha ung lytah ung hmai neh seh la, ka thinglung co naaning kha ka ung leimei thlang. Macawtaco ma hming a tuapaw cawngsaw cung lehei naaning kha a ung hrahpaw hratah kama cawh biachawnah ka tua thah myca.
Kaa Buipaw Zisu ming tah na pahmo tih he ceh tah ka thinglung tah naaning kha ung hrah neh ka, kaa Buipaw Zisu a hmingtuakhynah zong a ung hrah.
Ma cawngsawpaw cawh Setan khah pei thlang o, ma pawsui co a ngaisaw phung khah ro cang ka, a thlawpaw cawh Abuipaw ning letah pachah a cang khy a.
Na pachawpaw he ceh heh chah be. Raangri a cawngtei tah vedi nong ciapaw a hlungpui khah a thosah tahpaw hnih thlang bei he ceh maw?

Raangri a paringpaw khah singsi thlu la, raangri lypaw vedi a thapaw tah naa cang khy a, naa cang rua hrahringpaw zong a cang. Zecawtamaw tatah Khri, kaa Khungsai Panawnah tuu teitei cawh a thuihlainah letah hlai a cang thah cawtah.
Macawtaco ma panawnah cawh raangri a paringpaw a cangpaw a rai lynah le chahlynah raangri khei cang lytah raangri lypaw very, a huikongnah le biahmuisui very khei tua hri he peh.
Ca ka ca kuapaw he lekhei a pheila a hmangpaw mehchawly cawngsaw khatah a kong ly rua pawtah cia neh ka,

mehchawly a cangpaw khazaw cawngsaw sahlo le a du a sahpaw mehing mehru sahlo le nono a behpaw sahlo kha a pahlawh khe o tahnah cang be. Aaning sahlo khahei a pahlawh naa du ly caco, ma alui raang taihei naa seihly a hy a.

Canghrasala atoheh cawh ahohmai uny ka cang tah tlung katei, a pheila a hmangpaw mehchawly, a du a sahpaw, nono a behpaw, kongchia rei a hmangpaw, zurui a hmangpaw, mehing mehru khatah na huikong ruapaw he ceh cang be. Ma hapaw cawngsaw khaco batui hmai e hrui khe o.
Khrisawbu alailang cawngsaw a cangpaw sahlo aa kong cepah heh ka rai a cang maw? Canghrasala a chung leteipaw sahlo aa kong cawh a cepah ruapaw cang thlang bei he ceh maw?
Khrisawbu alailang teipaw cawh Khazing tah a ce tae thlang he. Capathai letah, “Mehchaw ly cawh naa hrong taitah papia my lo,” a tah kho!
